dashboard_desc: Live snapshot of companies, properties, complaints, and work orders.
dash_platform_desc: Live reporting across companies, access, complaints, and field work.
dash_company_desc: Open work, overdue jobs, and the numbers that need attention today.
dash_volume_desc: Complaints submitted vs work orders created.
dash_category_desc: Where complaints and jobs are concentrating.
dash_empty_wo: No overdue, held, or unassigned jobs.
dash_empty_access: No companies are missing access or ending trial.
dash_empty_trials: No trials ending in the next 14 days.
dash_empty_duty: No technicians are on duty right now.
dash_empty_pm: No preventive jobs due in the next 7 days.
dash_empty_desc: Once companies, complaints, and work orders exist, reporting will appear here.
companies_desc: Manage tenant companies across the platform.
users_desc: Company users, roles, and property assignments.
complaints_desc: Tenant requests and their work-order lifecycle.
work_orders_desc: Assign crews, track progress, and close jobs with a full audit trail.
pm_schedules_desc: Schedules generate work orders automatically on the due date.
pm_form_desc: Pick a property, service, and the next due date. PMMS will raise a work order when it comes due.
pm_empty_desc: Create a schedule so PMMS can open work orders automatically on the due date.
pm_history_empty: No completed work orders for this schedule yet.
categories_desc: Activate or deactivate taxonomy without losing history.
categories_only_desc: Complaint and work-order categories. Services are managed separately.
services_desc: Services belong to a category and appear on complaints and work orders.
category_form_desc: A category groups related services for complaints and work orders.
visible_to_tenant_desc: When disabled, tenants cannot select this category.
visible_to_tenant_service_desc: When disabled, tenants cannot select this service.
service_form_desc: A service sits under one category and is selected on complaints and jobs.
no_categories_desc: Create HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, and other complaint groups first.
no_services_desc: Create a category first, then add services such as AC repair or leak fix.
wo_settings_desc: Company policy for intake, holds, evidence, field checks, and closure.
wo_company_scope_desc: These rules apply to one company at a time.
wo_group_intake_desc: How new complaints are accepted when a similar request already exists.
wo_group_assignment_desc: How complaints reach supervisors and technicians when a shift is empty.
wo_group_lifecycle_desc: Holds, reopen, verification, and rating windows.
wo_auto_technician_assignment_desc: When no supervisor is on duty, convert the complaint to a work order and assign an eligible on-duty technician.
wo_nearest_technician_desc: When automatic assignment is on, also prefer the closest technician by GPS. Off ignores location.
wo_group_evidence_desc: Photos and parts required before a job can be completed.
wo_group_field_desc: GPS, asset scan, and live tracking rules for technicians.
wo_group_stock_desc: How parts can be issued against work orders.
wo_duplicate_complaint_rule_desc: Allow, warn, or block a new complaint that matches an open request.
wo_work_order_reopen_enabled_desc: Supervisors can reopen a closed job within the category window.
wo_force_assignment_desc: Technicians cannot reject an assigned job. They must accept and start it.
wo_max_hold_count_desc: How many times a job can be put on hold. Leave empty for unlimited.
wo_sla_pauses_on_hold_desc: Stop the SLA clock while a work order is on hold.
wo_allow_close_without_verify_desc: Supervisors can close a completed job without a separate verify step.
wo_rating_window_hours_desc: Hours after close during which a tenant can rate the job.
wo_require_before_photos_desc: Technicians must upload before photos before completing the job.
wo_require_after_photos_desc: Technicians must upload after photos before completing the job.
wo_require_parts_on_complete_desc: A completed job must record parts used, or confirm that none were needed.
wo_require_gps_checkin_desc: Technicians must check in at the site before starting work.
wo_require_gps_checkout_desc: Technicians must check out at the site before completing the job.
wo_require_asset_scan_to_start_desc: The assigned asset QR/code must be scanned before the job can start.
wo_tracking_interval_seconds_desc: How often an on-duty technician location is recorded.
wo_allow_negative_stock_desc: Parts can be issued even when the stock location is at zero.
calendar_desc: Working days, slot length, and holidays used for complaint booking.
cal_readonly: Only a Super Admin can change the platform calendar.
cal_hours_hint: Complaint booking slots are generated between these hours on working days.
cal_days_title: Days tenants can book a slot
cal_days_hint: Qatar default is Sunday–Thursday. Friday and Saturday stay off unless you enable them.
cal_days_required: Select at least one working day
cal_holidays_title: Closed dates are skipped when booking
cal_holiday_required: Date and English name are required
cal_no_holidays_desc: National and company closed days will be skipped in complaint slot booking.
new_complaint_desc: Capture the issue, category, and preferred slot.
manual_work_order_desc: Create a job for a vacant unit or common area.
company_form_desc: Company profile, access (trial or plan), and the first company admin.
company_details_desc: Identity, contact, timezone, and language for this tenant.
name: Name
access_desc: Start this company on a trial or assign a paid plan now.
start_trial_desc: Uses the platform default trial length.
assign_paid_plan_desc: Pick a plan and convert any future trial automatically.
access_later_desc: Create the company only. Assign a plan from Subscriptions.
company_admin_desc: This user can sign in and manage the company portal.
no_access: No trial or paid plan assigned yet.
no_admins: No company admin has been created yet.
property_form_desc: Name, code, type, address, contact, and map pin. Codes must be unique inside the company.
duty_desc: Turn duty on to receive jobs and share your live location.
duty_tracking_active: Location tracking is active while you are on duty.
duty_tracking_off: Location is not tracked while duty is off.
duty_on_success: You are on duty. Location tracking is active.
duty_off_success: You are off duty. Location tracking has stopped.
my_jobs_desc: Jobs assigned to you. Open a card to check in, start, or close the work.
no_jobs_desc: When a supervisor assigns work, it will appear here.
privacy_body: While Duty is ON, the app records your location at a regular interval so supervisors can see on-duty technicians on the live map. Tracking stops when you turn Duty OFF, log out, or revoke location permission.
live_map_desc: On-duty technicians in your permitted scope.
route_desc: Current-day location history, tenant-scoped and time ordered.
subscriptions_desc: Plans, company assignments, and feature packs in one place.
plan_form_desc: Limits and feature pack companies subscribe to.
plan_active_desc: Inactive plans stay on existing subscriptions but cannot be newly assigned.
subscription_form_desc: Attach a plan to a company. An active paid plan converts any open trial.
choose_plan_desc: Compare limits and features, then assign one pack.
auto_renew_desc: Keep the company on this plan when the end date is reached.
no_subscriptions_desc: Create a plan first, then assign it to a company.
no_plans_desc: Create Starter, Professional, and Enterprise packs before assigning subscriptions.
platform_settings_desc: Backend-defined defaults for every company. Edit values here — keys are not created from this screen.
no_settings_desc: The backend catalog has not published any settings yet.
languages_desc: Tenant-facing locales used by companies and the technician app.
shift_hours_hint: Leave empty if this supervisor is always on duty for the property.
prop_identity_desc: Required fields. Duplicate codes in the same company are blocked.
prop_address_desc: Street address used on complaints, work orders, and navigation.
prop_contact_desc: Site contact for technicians and supervisors.
prop_maps_desc: Search or click the map to drop a pin. Coordinates are stored and opened with the same Google Maps link on web and mobile.
prop_maps_click: Click the map or search a place to drop a pin.
prop_maps_empty: Add coordinates to generate a navigation link.
prop_hierarchy_desc: Each child belongs to one parent. Archive a node instead of deleting it so history stays readable.
no_locations_desc: Add a building, wing, or block under this property.
tenant_reopen_limit_required: Set the tenant reopen time limit, or turn tenant reopen off.
admin_reopen_limit_required: Set the admin/supervisor reopen time limit, or choose Unlimited.
company_categories_desc: Select the categories and services your company uses from the master list, then set your own rules for each one.
no_master_categories_desc: Ask the platform administrator to add categories to the master list.
select_category_hint: Turn on “Use” to select this category and configure it for your company.
reopen_window_duration_hint: Also the tenant reopen time limit.
tenant_reopen_desc: Tenants can reopen a closed job within the reopen window.
admin_reopen_desc: Company admins and supervisors can reopen closed jobs.
company_services_hint: Enable the services your company offers in this category. Services are created by the platform administrator.
master_categories_desc: Platform-wide categories. Companies select from this list; only Super Admin can create or edit them.
master_category_form_desc: Master categories are shared by all companies. Each company selects the ones it needs and sets its own rules.
category_icon_hint: PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP up to 2 MB.
master_services_desc: Platform-wide services under each master category. Companies enable the ones they offer.
plan_feature_delete_confirm: Delete this feature? This cannot be undone.
plan_features_desc: The features subscription plans can include. Changes apply to plan screens and feature locks right away.
no_features_in_group: No features in this group yet.
feature_key_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Generated from the name if empty.
feature_form_desc: Inactive features are hidden from plans and locked for every company.
feature_href_hint: Page opened from the dashboard module card, e.g. /work-orders
feature_api_paths_hint: One per line, without /api/v1. Use {id} for a record id, e.g. work-orders/{id}/check-in
feature_web_paths_hint: One per line, e.g. /work-orders. Sub-pages are included.
company_categories_hint: Selected categories start with default settings. The company admin can adjust rules, services and tenant visibility later.
company_categories_assign_desc: Assign master categories and the services this company offers.
adjust_quantity_hint: Use a negative number to reduce stock.
stock_logs_overview_desc: Stock-in, stock-out, issue, usage, return, and adjustment history across all parts. To record stock, use Manage stock on a part.
stock_locations_desc: Stores and warehouses where spare parts are kept. Stock in and out is recorded against a location.
no_stock_locations: No stock locations yet. Add your first store above.
add_at_least_one_part: Add at least one part with a quantity
technician_hand_stock_desc: Parts carried by each technician. Issue from the store or return to the store — these parts are not linked to any work order until the technician uses them.
select_technician_hint: Select a technician to view and manage their hand stock.
no_hand_stock: This technician is not holding any parts.
checklist_create_wo_prompt: This item failed. Do you want to create a work order to rectify?
checklist_fail_prompt: Item failed. A supervisor must create a corrective work order.
checklist_properties_hint: Leave empty to use this checklist for all properties.
checklist_settings_desc: Configure items per property or category. Deactivating an item keeps historical results.
checklist_skip_reason_required: Enter the reason for not creating a work order
checklist_start_failed: Unable to start checklist. GPS at the site is required.
daily_checklists_desc: Supervisors and technicians start a checklist only after GPS verification at the property.
item_inactive_history: Item later deactivated. This historical result is kept.
checklist_pending_items: {count} items still need Pass or Fail
invoice_lines_required: Add at least one invoice line.
invoice_form_desc: Drafts stay editable until you issue them. Issued invoices can only be corrected with a reason.
trial_company_invoice_warning: This company is on a trial. Convert it to a paid plan before invoicing.
correction_notice: Corrections keep the invoice number and payment history. The original and corrected amounts, reason, person and time are recorded.
invoice_issued: Invoice issued and emailed to the company
snapshot_on_issue: Company details are captured when the invoice is issued.
invoices_desc: Subscription invoices for every company. Payments are recorded manually.
no_invoices_desc: Paid subscriptions create draft invoices automatically. You can also create one manually.
restriction_policy_block_login: Policy: company users cannot sign in.
restriction_policy_inactive: The current platform policy does not restrict access.
restriction_lifts_on_payment: It lifts automatically once overdue invoices are paid.
standard_pricing_desc: Leave a cell empty when the plan is not sold in that currency or cycle. Changing prices never changes existing invoices.
billing_pricing_desc: A special price applies to this company only and never changes the plan's standard price.
no_plan_price_warning: This plan has no standard price for the selected currency and cycle. Set a special price, or it will be treated as free and no invoice will be drafted.
subscription_renewed: Subscription renewed. A draft invoice is ready for review.
dash_filters_desc: Filters apply to the numbers, charts and lists on this dashboard.
dash_analytics_desc: 14-day volume, status, priority, type and category mix.
dash_queue_desc: Pending and unassigned first, then assigned, in progress, on hold, completed and closed.
dash_queue_empty: No complaints or work orders match these filters.
